news.title: Neighborhood 'auntie' injured on her Atlanta porch in senseless double shooting
news.summary: An 85-year-old woman and a 21-year-old man were wounded in a double shooting near Browns Mill Road SE in Atlanta.

news.title: Atlanta felon sentenced to 15 years for dealing fentanyl
